name: How much does it cost to replace flooring in the Daly City area?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to replace flooring in the Daly City area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flooring replacement costs in the Daly City area depend on the material chosen, the total square footage, and the complexity of the installation. For example, luxury vinyl plank might range from $4-$8 per square foot installed, while engineered hardwood can be $8-$15+ per square foot. These figures typically include materials and labor but can vary based on subfloor conditions and waste removal.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs in Daly City vary by material and square footage; for example, LVP might be $4-$8/sq ft installed, while engineered hardwood could be $8-$15+/sq ft.
